issue.title: [DOCS] Fix allowed `refresh` args for several doc APIs

labels.name: :Distributed/CRUD
labels.description: A catch all label for issues around indexing, updating and getting a doc by id. Not search.

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
We incorrectly list `wait_for` as a valid `refresh` argument for the
following APIs:

* Delete by query
* Multi get
* Reindex

This fixes that error. It also updates the get API docs for consistency.

Closes #65031
